# Prime Women

> > An online magazine for women featuring health, nutrition, relationships, fashion, and lifestyle content tailored for midlife and beyond.

Prime Women provides practical advice and curated recommendations across wellness, style, and life planning. Content includes recipes, fashion guides from retailers like Nordstrom and Anthropologie, relationship guidance, and mental health resources.

## Key Topics

- Healthy eating and nutrition
- Low-calorie recipes
- Pre-marriage planning
- Financial planning
- Estate planning
- Holiday fashion
- Mental health and wellness
- Stress relief
- Relationship advice
- Breakfast recipes
- Quinoa salad
- Nordstrom
- Anthropologie
- CBD wellness products
- Midlife lifestyle

## Health & Nutrition

- [Delicious Low-Calorie Recipes That Are Sure To Please!](https://primewomen.com/web-stories/delicious-low-calorie-recipes-that-are-sure-to-please/): Six low-calorie recipes featuring quinoa salad, zucchini noodles & more
- [Low-Fat Breakfast Recipes to Start Your Day Right](https://primewomen.com/web-stories/low-fat-breakfast-recipes-to-start-your-day-right/): Six healthy low-fat breakfast recipes including smoothie bowls

## Relationships & Life Planning

- [Things to do Before Saying "I Do"](https://primewomen.com/web-stories/things-to-do-before-saying-i-do/): Pre-marriage planning guide covering finances, prenups & estate planning

## Fashion & Style

- [Essentials for Your Chic Holiday Wardrobe](https://primewomen.com/web-stories/essentials-for-your-chic-holiday-wardrobe/): Holiday fashion guide featuring dressy basics from Nordstrom & Anthropologie

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Mental Health Boosters for a Better You](https://primewomen.com/web-stories/mental-health-boosters-for-a-better-you/): Mental health tips featuring CBD & Ashwagandha stress relief products
